children: , the world's advanced-chip factory, jumped nearly 3% to $428.91 Monday as Taiwan transformed silicon supremacy into geopolitical muscle. Reuters reported that the island is using semiconductor investment to tighten its relationships with the United States and Europe while both regions scramble for more manufacturing capacity.

TSMC's Arizona bet has ballooned to $265 billion after another $100 billion expansion. The U.S. Commerce Department said the program covers 12 American facilities. The company has the financial firepower to fund that push: second-quarter results delivered $40.2 billion in revenue, a 67.7% gross margin and a staggering 60.3% operating margin.

Investors are already paying heavily for that dominance. At $428.91, TSMC trades 19.35% above its GF Value estimate of $359.38, leaving little room for an expensive overseas stumble. Arizona can lock in customers, blunt tariff risk and buy political goodwillbut TSMC must prove it can export Taiwan's manufacturing magic without leaving its extraordinary margins behind.

title: TSMC Rises Nearly 3% as $265 Billion Becomes Taiwan's Diplomatic Currency
